items.name: feedbax-feedback
items.title: Feedbax Feedback
items.description: A responsive feedback form that opens in a dialog on desktop and a drawer on mobile.
items.docs: Keep FEEDBAX_API_SECRET and FEEDBAX_API_BASE_URL in server-only environment configuration. Create the client in your server handler and pass the browser component an onSubmit callback that invokes that handler. Never import feedbax-client.server.ts from a client module. Optional findSimilar behavior should call your public server-side search adapter.
